body:
I’ve been doing a lot of shooting lately – not guns, film.

In LA, I contributed to an upcoming documentary on genetically modified organisms.

Here in Minneapolis, I’ll be contributing to a new resource from the good people of Sparkhouse. More on the project soon.

Then back to Florida late tonight for a few days of rest (and catching up on a huge mountain of email).
